subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add normal-session max-age and max-turn automatic rotation, and what public config plus memory-continuity contract should it use?
rationale: The missing source path is clear, but the fix defines new public lifecycle config and state-preservation behavior that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve opt-in lifecycle policy
options.body: Add disabled-by-default max-age and max-turn triggers under the session reset lifecycle with explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

options.title: Fold into broader session-boundary design
options.body: Keep this issue open as a requirement but implement it only with the broader token-pressure, pruning, and reset-memory design work.

options.title: Defer automatic rotation
options.body: Keep daily, idle, compaction, context-pruning, and manual reset as the supported paths while documenting external hygiene as an operator workaround.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Add disabled-by-default max-age and max-turn triggers under the session reset lifecycle with explicit pre-rotation memory and continuity semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The central history points to the daily reset policy and cross-boundary lifecycle behavior, making steipete the best available routing owner for the product choice.
